guide.safety: CoreRobin suggests only evidence-backed actions. Any system action still needs your confirmation.

slow.title: Find out why your computer feels slow
slow.description: Watch for sustained changes first, then show the most likely reason and a safe next step.
slow.observingTitle: First, make sure this is not a brief burst
slow.observingDescription: About {{seconds}} seconds remain. Opening a page or launching an app is not treated as a fault.
slow.normalTitle: No sustained resource pressure was found
slow.normalDescription: If it still feels slow, review the current apps. CoreRobin will not guess without evidence.
slow.applicationExplanation: {{name}} had sustained activity at the same time as this issue.

space.title: See whether space is actually running low
space.description: Check what remains first, then decide whether a full file analysis is useful.
space.lowDescription: Find large files and reclaimable content first instead of blindly deleting system caches.
space.normalDescription: Space is not tight. Scan only if you actually want to organize files.
space.unknownTitle: The main disk is temporarily unavailable
space.unknownDescription: The system did not provide reliable capacity data, so CoreRobin will not treat the unknown state as enough space.
space.scanExplanation: A full scan builds an interactive space map and never deletes automatically.

startup.title: See which apps open when you sign in
startup.description: Prioritize recoverable third-party sign-in items while keeping system services read-only.
startup.resultTitle: Start with items that are actually worth reviewing
startup.resultDescription: Disabling an item only stops its next automatic launch. It does not uninstall the app.

heat.title: See why it feels hot or drains quickly
heat.description: Check temperature, battery, and sleep blockers separately without calling one reading a hardware fault.
heat.sleepDescription: Quitting the app or pausing its task will usually restore sleep.
heat.viewApplications: See apps with the largest impact now

temperature.title: This computer is running warm
temperature.description: Pause heavy work and keep airflow clear. Check again after the temperature has time to settle.

battery.title: The remaining battery is low
battery.description: This reading only shows a low charge. Keep watching running apps if the battery still drops unusually fast.

sleep.title: {{name}} is keeping the computer awake
sleep.description: This may increase standby drain. Quitting the app or pausing its task will usually restore sleep.

unknown.title: There is not enough device information yet
unknown.description: Temperature, battery, and sleep data are unavailable, so CoreRobin cannot judge heat or drain.

normal.title: No sustained heat or sleep issue was found
normal.description: Temperature, battery, and automatic sleep do not currently provide evidence of a problem.

network.title: See what the network is doing now
network.description: CoreRobin reads current traffic and active connections, but it will not blame an app without evidence.
network.checkingDescription: Connection scanning uses a separate low-frequency command and does not affect the main sampler.
network.unknownTitle: There is not enough network information yet
network.unknownDescription: Current traffic or connections are unavailable, so CoreRobin cannot say whether the network is healthy.
network.quietTitle: There is no significant network activity now
network.resultDescription: This describes current activity only. Slow internet may also come from the router, provider, or remote service.

checkup.title: See how this computer is doing
checkup.description: Turn the latest state into one main conclusion and keep watching when the evidence is not ready.
checkup.observingTitle: Watch a little longer to avoid a false alarm
checkup.observingDescription: About {{seconds}} seconds remain. Brief app launches are not treated as sustained problems.
checkup.normalDescription: No sustained app activity, real memory pressure, or low space was found. Nothing needs to be done.
